summary: Role-run validation now requires observed_changed_files for contract_version 2+ manifests, checks each observed file against allowed_target_files and the referenced role contract write surfaces/forbidden patterns, and role-contract validation requires implementation_writer to model the BANDIT-060 artifact-input policy/support surfaces when the artifact-input policy is present. Historical contract_version 1 manifests remain valid append-only evidence.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: Role-run validation fails closed when future contract_version 2 manifests omit observed_changed_files.
acceptance_coverage.evidence: validateObservedChangedFiles requires observed_changed_files for contract_version 2+. test/role-run-manifests.test.mjs passes 9/9.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: Role-run validation rejects observed changed files absent from allowed_target_files.
acceptance_coverage.evidence: Each observed file is checked against allowed_target_files before write-surface checks; diagnostic names the offending file.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: Role-run validation rejects observed changed files outside contract write surfaces or matching forbidden patterns.
acceptance_coverage.evidence: Observed files are checked with isTargetFileAllowed against allowed_write_surface_families and forbidden_file_patterns; observed check runs before the declared-target check.
Observed check returns early below contract_version 2; npm run bandit -- validate keeps BANDIT-058/059/060 manifests valid.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: implementation_writer models BANDIT-060 artifact-input policy/support surfaces.
acceptance_coverage.evidence: validateImplementationWriterSurfaces requires .bandit/policy/artifact-inputs.json, docs/artifact-inputs/**, docs/reviewer-captures/.gitkeep, docs/trust-snapshot-fixtures/.gitkeep when the artifact-input policy exists; role-contracts.json declares all four. test/role-contracts.test.mjs passes 5/5.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: Stage 3 refusal of tests, RED evidence, and acceptance mappings preserved.
acceptance_coverage.evidence: Existing test-surface refusal unchanged; no test/RED/acceptance surfaces added to role-contracts.json.

verification.command: npm run bandit -- role-runs validate BANDIT-061 --json

clean_code_self_check: Spec-aligned, small surface area, simple design reusing isTargetFileAllowed with a shared stringArray helper, explicit named checks, clear fail-closed messages, no hidden authority, no role erosion.
test_ownership_boundary: Codex PM/Test Writer authored the Stage 2 RED tests, test helpers, RED evidence, and acceptance mappings. Stage 3 Writer changed none of them.
bootstrap_model_family_separation: Codex authored the Stage 2 RED tests, so Stage 3 was dispatched to Claude through the bootstrap Process Adapter path as claude-implementation-writer-stage3.
authority_boundary: Role contracts and role-run manifests remain append-only evidence and derived non-canonical projections. They do not replace coordination logs, review evidence, landing evidence, UAT, retrospective evidence, roadmap/current-context state, or bootstrap-gap ledger authority. The artifact-input taxonomy remains policy evidence, not workflow-state authority.
